note: Visitor assistant eval set (Site 3.0 stage 3, D-132). 'coverage' cases are written by the build over the fixture catalogue in test/visitor-fixture.ts; 'isaac-slot' entries are empty places for Isaac's own questions (skipped until he sends them). Every case is graded on the universal checks (no card outside the catalogue, no wrong or invented price, no invented title, 'affordable' never used, handoff when expected) plus its own `expect`. `replay` is the model's steps, as recorded by `pnpm --filter @studio/assistant eval:visitor -- --record` (written to visitor-cases.recorded.json); null = not recorded yet.
